acct.age_tip.en: {n} days old: the next statement or update refreshes it
acct.age_tip.zh: 已过 {n} 天，下一份对账单或下次导入时会更新

acct.loan_note.en: Loan of {amount} agreed on {date}. {back} has been repaid since. Each repayment is deducted from the balance automatically.
acct.loan_note.zh: {date}约定借款 {amount}，此后已还款 {back}。每笔还款会自动从余额中扣除。

acct.loan_note_last.en: Loan of {amount} agreed on {date}. {back} has been repaid since, most recently on {last}. Each repayment is deducted from the balance automatically.
acct.loan_note_last.zh: {date}约定借款 {amount}，此后已还款 {back}，最近一笔于 {last}。每笔还款会自动从余额中扣除。

acct.loan_quiet.en: No repayment has been received from {name} in {n} days. {amount} is still owed. You can ask when the next repayment is due, or agree on a new amount and date.
acct.loan_quiet.zh: 已有 {n} 天未收到 {name} 的还款，尚欠 {amount}。可询问下一笔还款的时间，或重新约定金额和日期。

acct.no_match.zh: 没有符合搜索条件的交易。

acct.show_more.zh: 再显示 {n} 条（共还有 {m} 条）

acct.tot_missing_many.en: {n} accounts have no balance and are not included.
acct.tot_missing_many.zh: 有 {n} 个账户没有余额，未计入。

acct.tot_missing_one.en: 1 account has no balance and is not included.
acct.tot_missing_one.zh: 有 1 个账户没有余额，未计入。

acct.tot_plus_own_apart.en: + {amount} in non-financial assets ⚠ Differs from net worth by {diff}
acct.tot_plus_own_apart.zh: + 非金融资产 {amount}，⚠ 与净值相差 {diff}

base.chart_empty.en: No full months of spending yet.
base.chart_empty.zh: 尚无完整月份的支出记录。

base.every_month.en: Every month, and which ones the average came from
base.every_month.zh: 各月支出及计入平均值的月份

base.ready_after_one.en: Ready after one more full month

base.ready_after_three.en: Ready after three more full months

base.ready_after_two.en: Ready after two more full months

base.skip_partial_first.en: Some statements begin after the first of the month ({accounts})
base.skip_partial_first.zh: 部分对账单并非从当月 1 日开始（{accounts}）

base.usual_note.en: Everything spent, averaged over your last full months, unusual ones left out.
base.usual_note.zh: 全部支出按最近几个完整月份取平均值，异常月份不计入。

base.usual_status.zh: 按 {n} 个完整月份计算

bt.caveat.en: This backtest uses US market history, the best-performing stock market of the past century, and the periods tested overlap. The actual success rate is likely lower.
bt.caveat.zh: 此回测使用美国市场的历史数据。美国股市是过去一个世纪表现最好的股市，且各测试期相互重叠，因此实际成功率可能更低。

bt.empty_never.en: No backtest is possible: the portfolio is empty at the age withdrawals start.
bt.empty_never.zh: 无法回测：开始提取时，投资组合已无资金。

bt.empty_no_history.en: Historical return data is not available yet. It is added at the next update.
bt.empty_no_history.zh: 尚无历史回报数据，将在下次导入时添加。

bt.key_lasted.zh: 未耗尽：{end} 岁时的剩余金额

bt.key_ran_out.en: Ran out: the longer the bar, the earlier
bt.key_ran_out.zh: 已耗尽：柱越长，耗尽越早

bt.mix_note.en: Stocks take the returns of the S&P 500, bonds the 10-year US Treasury, cash the 3-month US T-bill and gold the price of gold. Crypto has less than a century of history and is counted as stocks.
bt.mix_note.zh: 股票按标普 500 的回报计算，债券按美国 10 年期国债，现金按美国 3 个月期国库券，黄金按金价。加密货币的历史不足一百年，按股票计算。

bt.stretch_note.en: Each starting year begins with the portfolio you would have at {age} at a steady {pct} a year. Every year after that earns the actual real return of that year in history.
bt.stretch_note.zh: 每个起始年份的起点，是按每年稳定 {pct} 增长到 {age} 岁时的投资组合；此后每一年按历史上该年的实际回报（扣除通胀后）计算。

bt.title.zh: 按历史行情，资金能否维持？

bt.warn.en: Below 90%, the result depends heavily on the years in which withdrawals begin. Starting withdrawals later, spending less or having more invested at the start all raise the share of starting years that lasted.
bt.warn.zh: 低于 90% 时，结果在很大程度上取决于开始提取的年份。推迟开始提取、减少支出或开始时投资更多，都能提高资金未耗尽的起始年份所占比例。

budget.committed.note_default.en: Paid every month before anything is chosen.
budget.committed.note_default.zh: 每月优先支付，之后再分配其他项目。

budget.committed.stops_after_fire.zh: 实现 FIRE 后停止支付。

budget.everyday.note.en: Groceries, dining, transport, subscriptions, shopping — everything but bills and housing.
budget.everyday.note.zh: 食品杂货、外出就餐、交通、订阅、购物等，账单和住房除外。

budget.everyday_year.cap.en: Everyday spending stayed within the set amount in {kept} of {n} full months.
budget.everyday_year.cap.zh: {n} 个完整月份中，有 {kept} 个月的日常支出未超出设定金额。

budget.everyday_year.cap_none.en: No full month is available yet.

budget.everyday_year.tip.over.zh:
{month}
日常支出 {amount}
比设定的 {everyday} 高出 {diff}

budget.flow.cap.both.en: The plan allocates {used} a month, but income is {income}. Everyday spending exceeds the set amount by {amount}.
budget.flow.cap.both.zh: 计划每月分配 {used}，但收入为 {income}。日常支出超出设定金额 {amount}。

budget.flow.cap.over.en: Everyday spending exceeds the set amount by {amount}.
budget.flow.cap.over.zh: 日常支出超出设定金额 {amount}。

budget.flow.cap.short.en: The plan allocates {used} a month, but income is {income}.
budget.flow.cap.short.zh: 计划每月分配 {used}，但收入为 {income}。

budget.flow.label.short.en: Where the plan sends the money

budget.flow_aria.en: How income splits, and where everyday money went
budget.flow_aria.zh: 收入的分配及日常支出的去向

budget.invest.note.en: {amount} a month to {broker}. It goes before anything else is spent: that is paying yourself first.
budget.invest.note.zh: 每月 {amount} 转入 {broker}，在其他支出之前优先转出，即先付自己。

budget.saving.note_default.en: Monthly contribution to this savings goal.
budget.saving.note_default.zh: 每月存入此专项储蓄的金额。

budget.split.en: How each month's income is split

budget.split.edited_demo.many.en: {n} numbers were changed here. This is the demo, so the changes are shown but not saved.
budget.split.edited_demo.many.zh: 此处已修改 {n} 个数字。当前为演示版本，修改会显示，但不会保存。

budget.split.edited_demo.one.en: {n} number was changed here. This is the demo, so the change is shown but not saved.
budget.split.edited_demo.one.zh: 此处已修改 {n} 个数字。当前为演示版本，修改会显示，但不会保存。

budget.split.edited_saving.many.en: {n} numbers were changed and are being saved. The page reloads once they are saved.
budget.split.edited_saving.many.zh: 已修改 {n} 个数字，正在保存。保存完成后页面将重新加载。

budget.split.edited_saving.one.en: {n} number was changed and is being saved. The page reloads once it is saved.
budget.split.edited_saving.one.zh: 已修改 {n} 个数字，正在保存。保存完成后页面将重新加载。

budget.split.label.en: How each month's income is split

budget.split.warn_no_pay.en: This plan has no income, so the {amount} a month is drawn from savings. Enter take-home pay on the Settings page.
budget.split.warn_no_pay.zh: 此计划没有收入，每月 {amount} 将从储蓄中支出。请在「设置」页填写每月税后收入。

budget.split.warn_over.en: This plan allocates {used} a month, but income is {income}. The {gap} shortfall is drawn from savings. To close it, lower Everyday spending or Invest.
budget.split.warn_over.zh: 此计划每月分配 {used}，但收入为 {income}。差额 {gap} 将从储蓄中支出。如需补足，可调低日常支出或投资。

budget.unallocated.note.en: Income not assigned to any line of the plan. It remains in the account where the income is deposited.
budget.unallocated.note.zh: 未分配到计划任何一项的收入，留在收入入账的账户中。

budget.unset.tip.born.en: Not set yet. Your year of birth is needed for this figure.
budget.unset.tip.born.zh: 尚未设置。此项需要出生年份。

budget.unset.tip.everyday.en: Not set yet. Set Everyday spending on the Settings page.
budget.unset.tip.everyday.zh: 尚未设置。请在「设置」页设定每月日常支出。

budget.unset.tip.invest.en: Not set yet. Set the monthly Invest amount on the Settings page.
budget.unset.tip.invest.zh: 尚未设置。请在「设置」页设定每月投资金额。

budget.unset.tip.plan_base.en: Not set yet. Set Planned spending on the Settings page.
budget.unset.tip.plan_base.zh: 尚未设置。请在「设置」页设定每月规划支出。

budget.unset.tip.take_home.en: Not set yet. Set take-home pay on the Settings page.
budget.unset.tip.take_home.zh: 尚未设置。请在「设置」页设定每月税后收入。

care.extra_broke.en: The money runs out at {age}, before care starts
care.extra_broke.zh: 资金在 {age} 岁耗尽，早于护理开始

care.extra_label.zh: {age} 岁时需额外准备的护理资金

care.extra_note.en: The smallest additional amount needed at {age} for the portfolio to last to age {end}.
care.extra_note.zh: 使投资组合维持到 {end} 岁，{age} 岁时最少需额外准备的金额。

care.home_label.zh: 居家轻度护理，{age} 岁起

care.ltc_cap.en: From {age}, the care-home fee is added to your full planned spending, although a care home already covers rent and meals. The chart therefore overstates spending after {age}.
care.ltc_cap.zh: 从 {age} 岁起，护理院费用另加在全部规划支出之上计算，而护理院本身已包含房租和餐食，因此图中 {age} 岁以后的支出偏高。

care.rising_note.en: {description}. The cost is assumed to rise {pct} a year faster than inflation.
care.rising_note.zh: {description}。假设该费用每年涨幅比通胀高 {pct}。

cat.detail_usual_note.en: The median of this category over the last {n} full months.
cat.detail_usual_note.zh: 该类别过去 {n} 个完整月份的中位数。

cat.everyday.per_day.many.zh: 剩余 {n} 天，每天可支出 {amount}

cat.everyday.per_day.one.en: {amount} left for the last day of the month

cat.everyday.sum.note.en: Bills and housing are not in it.

cat.spent_line_parts.en: Spending in {month} was {amount}: {committed} in fixed costs and {everyday} in everyday spending.
cat.spent_line_parts.zh: {month}支出共 {amount}，其中固定支出 {committed}，日常支出 {everyday}。

cat.spent_line_refunds_parts.en: Spending in {month} was {amount} after {refunds} in refunds: {committed} in fixed costs and {everyday} in everyday spending.
cat.spent_line_refunds_parts.zh: {month}支出共 {amount}（已扣除退款 {refunds}），其中固定支出 {committed}，日常支出 {everyday}。

cat.vs_usual_note.en: The monthly average is taken over the {n} full months before this one. Months you set aside as unusual are left out.
cat.vs_usual_note.zh: 月均支出为本月之前 {n} 个完整月份的平均值，已标记为特殊的月份不计入。

coast.ltc_at.en: Move to a care home at

coast.say_never_reaches.en: Left alone at {pct} a year, today’s {amount} does not reach the {target} target within your lifetime.
coast.say_never_reaches.zh: 若不再追加投入，按每年 {pct} 增长，现有的 {amount} 在有生之年无法达到 {target} 的目标。

coast.say_nothing_invested.en: Nothing is invested yet, so nothing grows toward the target on its own.
coast.say_nothing_invested.zh: 尚无投资，因此没有资金可自行增长至目标。

coast.say_reaches.en: If you never added another dollar, today’s {amount} would grow into the {target} target on its own by about age {age}.
coast.say_reaches.zh: 即使不再追加投入，现有的 {amount} 也将自行增长，约在 {age} 岁达到 {target} 的目标。

coast.sec_lasted.zh: 按历史行情，资金能否维持？

draw.ans_hist_cap.en: Each starting year on record is replayed with your current asset allocation.
draw.ans_hist_cap.zh: 以当前资产配置，回放有记录的每个起始年份。

draw.ans_steady_label.zh: 按每年稳定 {pct} 的回报

draw.inflation_cap.en: Every figure is in today’s money, so the {amount} you invest each month has to rise with inflation each year to stay on this line.
draw.inflation_cap.zh: 所有数字均按当前币值计算，因此每月投资的 {amount} 需每年随通胀上调，才能保持在这条线上。

draw.line_empty.en: Nothing is invested yet, so there is nothing to withdraw. A withdrawal plan is shown once money is invested.
draw.line_empty.zh: 目前尚无投资，因此没有可提取的资金。有投资后，此处将显示提取计划。

draw.line_peak.en: The withdrawal rate starts at {pct} and rises to {peak_pct} around age {age}, above the 4% used by the 4% rule. Spending less or starting withdrawals later lowers it.
draw.line_peak.zh: 提取率从 {pct} 起步，在 {age} 岁左右升至 {peak_pct}，高于 4% 法则采用的 4%。减少支出或推迟开始提取，都可以降低提取率。

draw.line_runs_out_peak.en: The money does not last to age {end}. The withdrawal rate rises to {pct} around age {peak_age}, and the money runs out at age {age}. Spending less or starting withdrawals later makes it last longer.
draw.line_runs_out_peak.zh: 资金无法维持到 {end} 岁。提取率在 {peak_age} 岁左右升至 {pct}，资金在 {age} 岁耗尽。减少支出或推迟开始提取，可以延长资金的维持时间。

draw.line_runs_out_small.en: The money does not last to age {end}. When withdrawals start, the portfolio holds less than one year of spending, and it runs out at age {age}. Spending less or starting withdrawals later makes it last longer.
draw.line_runs_out_small.zh: 资金无法维持到 {end} 岁。开始提取时，投资组合中的资金不足一年支出，并将在 {age} 岁耗尽。减少支出或推迟开始提取，可以延长资金的维持时间。

draw.line_safe.en: Through age {age} the withdrawal rate never goes above {pct}.
draw.line_safe.zh: 到 {age} 岁为止，提取率始终不超过 {pct}。

draw.say.en: The ages below determine how long the money lasts and what care costs.
draw.say.zh: 以下年龄设置决定资金可维持的时间及护理费用。

fire.avg_sum.en: Average of the last {n} full months. Months with large expenses are included, because such expenses also occur after FIRE.
fire.avg_sum.zh: 最近 {n} 个完整月份的平均值。大额支出的月份也计入，因为实现 FIRE 后同样会有这类支出。

fire.avg_sum_short.en: Average of the {n} full months available so far. Once there are twelve, the last twelve are used. Months with large expenses are included, because such expenses also occur after FIRE.
fire.avg_sum_short.zh: 目前共有 {n} 个完整月份，取其平均值；满 12 个月后取最近 12 个月。大额支出的月份也计入，因为实现 FIRE 后同样会有这类支出。

fire.chart_aria.en: What you have invested, growing to the target
fire.chart_aria.zh: 已投资金额增长至目标的走势

fire.chart_cap.en: The dashed line is the FIRE target. Each line shows your portfolio at a real return of {g}% a year (your setting). The shaded band covers real returns from {lo}% to {hi}% a year. The years are estimates, not exact dates.
fire.chart_cap.zh: 虚线是 FIRE 目标。每条线表示投资组合按每年 {g}% 的实际回报率增长（见设置）。阴影区域为每年 {lo}% 至 {hi}% 的实际回报率范围。年数为估算，并非确切日期。

fire.demo_changed.en: Changed here to {amount}. This is the demo, so the change is not kept.
fire.demo_changed.zh: 已改为 {amount}。当前为演示版本，修改不会保存。

fire.draw_need_born.en: The drawdown is planned by age, and your year of birth is not set yet.
fire.draw_need_born.zh: 提取期按年龄规划，出生年份尚未设置。

fire.draw_need_plan.en: Whether the money lasts is measured against your planned spending, which is not set yet.
fire.draw_need_plan.zh: 资金能否维持，以规划支出为衡量标准，而规划支出尚未设置。

fire.drift_note_above.en: Real spending is {pct}% above the planning figure. Setting it to {amount} would make the target {target}.
fire.drift_note_above.zh: 实际支出比规划支出高 {pct}%。若改为 {amount}，目标将变为 {target}。

fire.drift_note_below.en: Real spending is {pct}% below the planning figure. Setting it to {amount} would make the target {target}.
fire.drift_note_below.zh: 实际支出比规划支出低 {pct}%。若改为 {amount}，目标将变为 {target}。

fire.fixed_not_in_spending.zh: 未计入支出的固定支出

fire.fixed_sum.en: Rent that starts at FIRE, and a mortgage or loan payment: the ones that continue after FIRE. Rent and bills paid today are in spending already; tuition is not counted, it ends.
fire.fixed_sum.zh: 实现 FIRE 时才开始支付的房租，以及 FIRE 后仍需偿还的房贷或贷款。目前支付的房租和账单已计入支出；学费将会结束，不计入。

fire.kept_line.en: Your surplus is {keep} a month, {pct}% of your earnings. This is your savings rate. It is divided as follows:
fire.kept_line.zh: 每月结余 {keep}，占收入的 {pct}%，即储蓄率。分配如下：

fire.less_ends_before.zh: 减：FIRE 前即会结束的支出（{categories}）

fire.more_res.en: Investing {amount} more a month: about {years} years.
fire.more_res.zh: 每月追加投资 {amount}：约 {years} 年。

fire.more_res_free.en: Investing {amount} more a month: about {years} years. That is about what is left over and not invested.
fire.more_res_free.zh: 每月追加投资 {amount}：约 {years} 年。该金额与未投资结余大致相当。

fire.more_res_sooner_many.en: Investing {amount} more a month: about {years} years — about {n} years sooner.
fire.more_res_sooner_many.zh: 每月追加投资 {amount}：约 {years} 年，提前约 {n} 年。

fire.more_res_sooner_many_free.en: Investing {amount} more a month: about {years} years — about {n} years sooner. That is about what is left over and not invested.
fire.more_res_sooner_many_free.zh: 每月追加投资 {amount}：约 {years} 年，提前约 {n} 年。该金额与未投资结余大致相当。

fire.more_res_sooner_one.en: Investing {amount} more a month: about {years} years — about {n} year sooner.
fire.more_res_sooner_one.zh: 每月追加投资 {amount}：约 {years} 年，提前约 {n} 年。

fire.more_res_sooner_one_free.en: Investing {amount} more a month: about {years} years — about {n} year sooner. That is about what is left over and not invested.
fire.more_res_sooner_one_free.zh: 每月追加投资 {amount}：约 {years} 年，提前约 {n} 年。该金额与未投资结余大致相当。

fire.more_zero.en: With no additional investment: about {years} years.

fire.overcommit.en: You set aside {amount} a month more than you keep; it comes out of what you already have.
fire.overcommit.zh: 每月计划分配的金额比结余多 {amount}，差额将从现有资金中支出。

fire.progress_sum.en: The portfolio as a share of the target.
fire.progress_sum.zh: 投资组合占目标的比例。

fire.say_done_plan.en: Your portfolio already covers 25 years of planned spending ({target}).
fire.say_done_plan.zh: 投资组合已足以覆盖 25 年的规划支出（{target}）。

fire.say_done_spend.en: What you have invested already covers 25 years of what you spend ({target}).
fire.say_done_spend.zh: 已投资金额已足以覆盖 25 年的支出（{target}）。

fire.say_no_pace.en: Nothing reaches {broker} each month yet, so what you have invested only grows on its own.
fire.say_no_pace.zh: 目前每月尚无资金转入 {broker}，已投资金额仅依靠自身增长。

fire.say_pace_planfig_many.en: The estimate uses the {amount} a month transferred to {broker} on average over the last {n} months, and counts the years until your portfolio covers 25 years of planned spending ({target}).
fire.say_pace_planfig_many.zh: 按最近 {n} 个月平均每月转入 {broker} 的 {amount}，估算投资组合足以覆盖 25 年规划支出（{target}）所需的年数。

fire.say_pace_planfig_one.en: The estimate uses the {amount} transferred to {broker} last month, and counts the years until your portfolio covers 25 years of planned spending ({target}).
fire.say_pace_planfig_one.zh: 按上个月转入 {broker} 的 {amount}，估算投资组合足以覆盖 25 年规划支出（{target}）所需的年数。

fire.say_pace_planfig_plan.en: The estimate uses the {amount} a month your budget allocates to {broker}, and counts the years until your portfolio covers 25 years of planned spending ({target}).
fire.say_pace_planfig_plan.zh: 按月度计划每月分配给 {broker} 的 {amount}，估算投资组合足以覆盖 25 年规划支出（{target}）所需的年数。

fire.say_pace_spend_many.en: The estimate uses the {amount} a month transferred to {broker} on average over the last {n} months, and counts the years until your portfolio covers 25 years of your spending ({target}).
fire.say_pace_spend_many.zh: 按最近 {n} 个月平均每月转入 {broker} 的 {amount}，估算投资组合足以覆盖 25 年支出（{target}）所需的年数。

fire.say_pace_spend_one.en: The estimate uses the {amount} transferred to {broker} last month, and counts the years until your portfolio covers 25 years of your spending ({target}).
fire.say_pace_spend_one.zh: 按上个月转入 {broker} 的 {amount}，估算投资组合足以覆盖 25 年支出（{target}）所需的年数。

fire.say_pace_spend_plan.en: The estimate uses the {amount} a month your budget allocates to {broker}, and counts the years until your portfolio covers 25 years of your spending ({target}).
fire.say_pace_spend_plan.zh: 按月度计划每月分配给 {broker} 的 {amount}，估算投资组合足以覆盖 25 年支出（{target}）所需的年数。

fire.spend_after_fire.en: Spending that goes on after FIRE
fire.spend_after_fire.zh: FIRE 后仍会发生的支出

fire.target_sum.en: 25 years of spending, from the 4% rule.
fire.target_sum.zh: 按 4% 法则，相当于 25 年的支出。

gloss.asset_allocation.def.en: How a portfolio is divided among asset classes such as stocks, bonds, cash and gold, as a share of each.
gloss.asset_allocation.def.zh: 投资组合在股票、债券、现金、黄金等资产类别之间的分配比例。

gloss.asset_class.def.en: A group of investments that behave alike: stocks, bonds, cash, gold.
gloss.asset_class.def.zh: 表现相似的一类投资：股票、债券、现金、黄金。

gloss.assets.def.en: Everything you own that has a money value: cash, investments, property, money others owe you.
gloss.assets.def.zh: 所拥有的、具有货币价值的一切：现金、投资、房产，以及应收款。

gloss.backtest.def.en: Running a plan through real past years to see how it would have done.
gloss.backtest.def.zh: 用真实的历史年份检验一项计划，看其当时的表现。

gloss.benchmark.def.en: A standard investment you compare your own results against.
gloss.benchmark.def.zh: 用于与自身投资结果比较的标准投资。

gloss.benchmark.eg.en: Did the portfolio beat a world index fund?
gloss.benchmark.eg.zh: 投资组合是否跑赢全球指数基金？

gloss.bond.def.en: A loan to a government or a company that pays interest and returns the money on a set date.
gloss.bond.def.zh: 向政府或公司提供的借款，按期支付利息，并在约定日期归还本金。

gloss.book_value.def.en: What you paid for an investment.
gloss.book_value.def.zh: 购买一项投资时支付的金额。

gloss.book_value.f.en: market value − book value = unrealized gain
gloss.book_value.f.zh: 市值 − 成本 = 浮盈

gloss.bucket.def.en: A group of holdings your investing rules are written about, such as dry powder. What no bucket claims falls into the last one.
gloss.bucket.def.zh: 投资规则所针对的一组持仓，例如待投现金。未归入其他分组的持仓，均归入最后一组。

gloss.card_interest.def.en: What a credit card charges on a balance not paid off. Paying the whole statement balance by the due date means no interest on purchases; leaving part of it unpaid is what starts it.
gloss.card_interest.def.zh: 信用卡对未还清余额收取的费用。在到期日前全额还清账单余额，消费不计利息；未还清部分余额，即开始计息。

gloss.card_interest.not.en: A fee, such as an annual fee, which is charged whatever you pay.
gloss.card_interest.not.zh: 不是指年费等费用，这类费用无论还款多少都会收取。

gloss.cash.def.en: Bank and cash accounts you live on and can spend today.
gloss.cash.def.zh: 日常生活使用、可随时动用的银行和现金账户。

gloss.cash_abroad.def.en: Cash held in another country, in its own currency. It counts in net worth; spending it here takes conversion.
gloss.cash_abroad.def.zh: 存放在其他国家、以当地货币持有的现金。计入净值；在本地使用需先换汇。

gloss.coast_fire.def.en: Having enough invested that, with nothing more added, growth alone reaches your target by the age you want to stop.
gloss.coast_fire.def.zh: 已投资的金额足够多，即使不再追加，仅靠增长也能在计划停止工作的年龄达到目标。

gloss.committed.def.en: A payment that is due every month regardless of other spending, such as rent, a mortgage or a loan.
gloss.committed.def.zh: 无论其他支出如何，每月都必须支付的款项，例如房租、房贷或贷款。

gloss.complete_to.def.en: The latest date for which every account’s figures are complete. After it, some accounts are still waiting for their next statement.
gloss.complete_to.def.zh: 所有账户数据均已齐全的最后日期。此日期之后，部分账户仍在等待下一份对账单。

gloss.compound_growth.def.en: Growth earned on earlier growth, so money grows faster the longer it is left alone.
gloss.compound_growth.def.zh: 在此前增长的基础上继续产生的增长，因此资金存放越久，增长越快。

gloss.contribution_room.def.en: How much a registered account still lets you put in. Unused TFSA and RRSP room carries forward in full; unused FHSA room carries forward only up to $8,000.
gloss.contribution_room.def.zh: 注册账户尚可存入的金额。TFSA 和 RRSP 未使用的额度可全额结转；FHSA 未使用的额度最多只能结转 $8,000。

gloss.core_satellite.def.en: Most of the money in broad index funds (the core), a smaller part in individual picks (the satellites).
gloss.core_satellite.def.zh: 大部分资金投入覆盖面广的指数基金（核心），较小部分投入自选的个股（卫星）。

gloss.cpp.def.en: Canada Pension Plan: a monthly pension for life, paid for by the contributions taken from your pay. What you will get depends on how long and how much you contributed; your My Service Canada account shows an estimate.
gloss.cpp.def.zh: 加拿大退休金计划：终身按月发放的养老金，资金来自从工资中扣缴的供款。领取金额取决于供款年限和供款金额；可在 My Service Canada 账户中查看估算金额。

gloss.dividend.def.en: Part of a company’s profit paid out to its shareholders.
gloss.dividend.def.zh: 公司将部分利润派发给股东的款项。

gloss.drawdown.def.en: The years when you live off your investments by taking money out.
gloss.drawdown.def.zh: 依靠从投资中提取资金维持生活的阶段。

gloss.drawdown.not.en: a market drawdown, a fall from a peak
gloss.drawdown.not.zh: 不是指市场回撤（从高点下跌）

gloss.dry_powder.def.en: Cash or near-cash kept ready to invest when prices fall.
gloss.dry_powder.def.zh: 预留的现金或类现金资产，待价格下跌时投资。

gloss.equity.def.en: The part of something you own outright once what is borrowed against it is taken off.
gloss.equity.def.zh: 一项资产扣除以其抵押的借款后，完全归自己所有的部分。

gloss.equity.eg.en: A $500k home with a $300k mortgage is $200k of equity.
gloss.equity.eg.zh: 一套价值 $500k 的房子，房贷 $300k，权益即为 $200k。

gloss.etf.def.en: Exchange-traded fund: a basket of investments that trades on the stock market like a single stock.
gloss.etf.def.zh: 交易所交易基金：一篮子投资，像单只股票一样在股市上交易。

gloss.everyday.def.en: The amount you set each month for day-to-day spending. Inside it, no purchase needs a reason. Bills and housing are not in it.
gloss.everyday.def.zh: 每月为日常支出设定的金额。在此范围内，任何消费都无需理由。账单和住房费用不在其中。

gloss.exchange_rate.def.en: How much of one currency buys one unit of another.
gloss.exchange_rate.def.zh: 购买一单位另一种货币所需的某种货币数量。

gloss.exchange_rate.eg.en: 1.39 Canadian dollars to one US dollar.

gloss.fhsa.def.en: First Home Savings Account. What you put in lowers your taxable income, like an RRSP; money taken out for a first home is tax-free, like a TFSA. It stays open fifteen years at most.
gloss.fhsa.def.zh: 首套房储蓄账户。存入的金额可像 RRSP 一样抵减应税收入；为购买首套房取出的资金像 TFSA 一样免税。账户最长可开立 15 年。

gloss.fire.def.en: Financial Independence, Retire Early: saving and investing until the returns can pay your living costs, so work becomes optional.
gloss.fire.def.zh: 财务自由、提前退休：持续储蓄和投资，直到投资回报足以支付生活支出，工作成为可选项。

gloss.fire_target.def.en: The portfolio that can pay your yearly spending for at least 30 years, by the 4% rule.
gloss.fire_target.def.zh: 按 4% 法则，足以支付每年支出至少 30 年的投资组合金额。

gloss.four_pct.def.en: A finding from US market history: taking 4% of the portfolio in the first year, then the same amount raised with inflation, lasted at least 30 years in almost every past period.
gloss.four_pct.def.zh: 源自美国市场历史的一项发现：第一年提取投资组合的 4%，此后每年提取相同金额并随通胀上调，在过去几乎所有时期中都能维持至少 30 年。

gloss.fund.def.en: A name you put on part of the money in one of your accounts, for something you are saving toward. Nothing is moved: the money stays where it is, and the plan can add to it each month.
gloss.fund.def.zh: 为某个账户中的一部分资金设定的名称，用于为某项目标储蓄。资金不会转移，仍留在原账户中；计划可每月向其追加。

gloss.grace_period.def.en: On a credit card, the days between the statement and the due date. Pay the whole balance in that window and no interest is charged.
gloss.grace_period.def.zh: 信用卡账单日至还款截止日之间的期间。在此期间内全额还清账单，不收取利息。

gloss.held_abroad.def.en: Money in another country. Bringing it home takes conversion, transfer limits and time.
gloss.held_abroad.def.zh: 存放在境外的资金。调回需要换汇，受转账限额限制，且需要一定时间。

gloss.in_property.def.en: What a property is worth minus what is still owed on it. You reach it only by selling or borrowing against it.
gloss.in_property.def.zh: 房产的市值减去尚欠的贷款。只有出售房产或以其抵押借款才能动用。

gloss.index_fund.def.en: A fund that holds a whole market index instead of picking stocks, so it rises and falls with that market.
gloss.index_fund.def.zh: 持有整个市场指数、而非挑选个股的基金，因此随该市场同步涨跌。

gloss.index_fund.eg.en: A fund that tracks the S&P 500.

gloss.inflation.def.en: The rise in prices over time, so the same money buys less each year.
gloss.inflation.def.zh: 物价随时间上涨，使同样的钱每年能购买的东西减少。

gloss.investment_income.def.en: What your investments pay you while you still hold them: dividends, interest and securities lending, after any tax withheld.
gloss.investment_income.def.zh: 持有投资期间获得的收入：分红、利息和证券出借收入，按扣除预扣税后的金额计算。

gloss.investment_income.eg.en: A fund paying $40 of dividends, less $6 withheld, is $34 of investment income.
gloss.investment_income.eg.zh: 一只基金派发 $40 分红，预扣 $6 税款，投资收入即为 $34。

gloss.investment_income.not.en: A gain from selling, which is not paid until you sell.
gloss.investment_income.not.zh: 卖出获得的收益不计入：卖出后才会实现。

gloss.kept.def.en: Income minus spending over the same months. Money moved to savings or investments counts as kept.
gloss.kept.def.zh: 同一时期内的收入减去支出。转入储蓄或投资的资金也计入结余。

gloss.lent_out.def.en: Money someone owes you. It comes back on their schedule, not yours.
gloss.lent_out.def.zh: 他人所欠的款项。何时归还取决于对方的安排，而非由你决定。

gloss.liabilities.def.en: Everything you owe: card balances, loans, a mortgage.
gloss.liabilities.def.zh: 所欠的全部款项：信用卡欠款、贷款、房贷。

gloss.liquidity.def.en: How quickly something can be turned into cash without losing value. Cash is the most liquid; a house is one of the least.
gloss.liquidity.def.zh: 资产在不损失价值的情况下转换为现金的速度。现金的流动性最高；房产是流动性最低的资产之一。

gloss.long_term_care.def.en: Help with daily living in later life, at home or in a care home. In a public care home the province pays for the care, and you pay a monthly fee it sets for the room and meals; private homes and extra help at home cost more.
gloss.long_term_care.def.zh: 晚年在日常生活方面获得的帮助，可在家中或护理院接受。在公立护理院，护理费用由省政府承担，房间和伙食费按省政府规定的标准每月缴纳；私立护理院和居家额外护理的费用更高。

gloss.market_value.def.en: What an investment would sell for today.
gloss.market_value.def.zh: 一项投资按今天的价格出售可得的金额。

gloss.median.def.en: The middle value once a list is sorted. Unlike the average, one unusual month barely moves it.
gloss.median.def.zh: 将一组数从小到大排列后位于中间的数值。与平均数不同，个别异常月份几乎不会影响它。

gloss.money_market.def.en: A fund that holds very short, very safe loans. It pays close to short-term interest rates and its price barely moves.
gloss.money_market.def.zh: 持有期限极短、安全性极高的债务工具的基金。收益接近短期利率，价格几乎不波动。

gloss.net_worth.def.en: What you own minus what you owe.
gloss.net_worth.def.zh: 拥有的资产减去所欠的款项。

gloss.net_worth.eg.en: A $500k home with a $300k mortgage adds $200k.
gloss.net_worth.eg.zh: 一套价值 $500k、尚有 $300k 房贷的房产，使净值增加 $200k。

gloss.non_registered.def.en: An ordinary investment account with no tax shelter. Dividends and interest are taxed in the year they are paid; a gain is taxed when you sell.
gloss.non_registered.def.zh: 没有税务优惠的普通投资账户。分红和利息在收到当年纳税；收益在卖出时纳税。

gloss.oas.def.en: Old Age Security: a monthly pension from 65 for people who have lived in Canada long enough after 18, whatever they earned. A full pension needs 40 years of residence; fewer years give part of it, and a high income in retirement reduces it.
gloss.oas.def.zh: 老年保障金：年满 65 岁起按月发放，发放对象为 18 岁以后在加拿大居住满一定年限的人，与收入高低无关。领取全额需居住满 40 年；年限不足可领取部分金额；退休后收入较高会被扣减。

gloss.other_assets.def.en: Things you own that are not money, such as a home or a car.
gloss.other_assets.def.zh: 所拥有的、不属于资金的财产，例如房产或汽车。

gloss.owed_to_you.def.en: Money you lent that has not come back yet.
gloss.owed_to_you.def.zh: 已借出、尚未收回的款项。

gloss.pay_yourself_first.def.en: Moving your saving out on payday, before any spending, so saving does not depend on what is left over.
gloss.pay_yourself_first.def.zh: 发薪当天、在任何支出之前先将储蓄转出，使储蓄不取决于支出后的剩余。

gloss.percentage_point.def.en: The difference between two percentages. A share that goes from 40% to 42% is up 2 percentage points, not 2%.
gloss.percentage_point.def.zh: 两个百分比之间的差值。比例从 40% 升至 42%，是上升 2 个百分点，而不是上升 2%。

gloss.planning_figure.def.en: The monthly spending your FIRE target is based on. You set it yourself; your actual spending does not change it and is used only for comparison.
gloss.planning_figure.def.zh: FIRE 目标所依据的每月支出。由你自行设定；实际支出不会改变它，仅用于对照。

gloss.portfolio.def.en: All the investments a person holds, taken together.
gloss.portfolio.def.zh: 一个人持有的全部投资的总和。

gloss.portfolio.here.en: The accounts you hold to grow. Money set aside for a goal is not in it.
gloss.portfolio.here.zh: 用于长期增值的账户。为特定目标专门留出的资金不计入在内。

gloss.promised_to_a_goal.def.en: Money you could take out, but only by giving up the goal it is set aside for.
gloss.promised_to_a_goal.def.zh: 可以取出的资金，但取出即意味着放弃其对应的目标。

gloss.real_return.eg.zh: 回报 7%、通胀 2%，实际回报约为 5%。

gloss.rebalance.def.en: To buy and sell so each part of a portfolio is back at its target share.
gloss.rebalance.def.zh: 通过买入和卖出，使投资组合各部分恢复到目标比例。

gloss.repayment.def.en: Money someone returns on a loan you made. It lowers what they owe you, and it is never income.
gloss.repayment.def.zh: 他人归还你借出的款项。它会减少对方所欠的金额，任何情况下都不计为收入。

gloss.rewards.def.en: Money a card pays back for spending on it: cash back, or points turned into money. It counts as income but never as pay, and it stays on the card.
gloss.rewards.def.zh: 信用卡按消费金额返还的钱：现金返现，或兑换成现金的积分。计为收入，但不计为工资，且留在卡内。

gloss.rewards.eg.en: 1% cash back on $2,000 of purchases is $20 of rewards.

gloss.rewards.not.en: A refund, which gives back a purchase and comes off spending.
gloss.rewards.not.zh: 退款不属于返现：退款是退回一笔消费，从支出中扣除。

gloss.rrsp.def.en: Registered Retirement Savings Plan. What you put in lowers your taxable income now; what you take out is taxed as income that year.
gloss.rrsp.def.zh: 注册退休储蓄计划。存入的金额可降低当年的应税收入；取出的金额计入当年收入纳税。

gloss.savings_rate.def.en: The share of income from work that is left after spending. It determines both how quickly your portfolio grows and how much each year after work will cost, so it affects the years to FIRE more than the level of pay does. Gifts, repayments and investment income are not counted as income from work.
gloss.savings_rate.def.zh: 工作收入中扣除支出后剩余的比例。它既决定投资组合增长的速度，也决定停止工作后每年的支出，因此对实现 FIRE 所需年数的影响大于工资高低。赠与、还款和投资收入都不计入工作收入。

gloss.securities_lending.def.en: Your broker lends your shares to other traders and gives you part of the fee. The shares stay yours.
gloss.securities_lending.def.zh: 券商将你持有的股票出借给其他交易者，并将部分费用分给你。股票的所有权不变。

gloss.sequence_risk.def.en: Bad years soon after you start taking money out do far more damage than the same bad years later on.
gloss.sequence_risk.def.zh: 开始提取资金后不久遭遇市场下跌，造成的损失远大于晚些时候出现的同等下跌。

gloss.set_aside.def.en: Money promised to a goal, such as a first home or a trip. It is left out of FIRE progress and out of dry powder.
gloss.set_aside.def.zh: 已指定用途的资金，例如购买首套房或一次旅行。不计入 FIRE 进度，也不计入待投现金。

gloss.shortfall.def.en: What is still to pay after the money set aside for it has run out. It says how much is missing, not where it would come from.
gloss.shortfall.def.zh: 专门留出的资金用完后仍需支付的部分。它只表示差额多少，不表示资金从何而来。

gloss.spendable_today.def.en: Money you could spend today with no tax, no penalty and no wait.
gloss.spendable_today.def.zh: 今天即可使用、无需缴税、没有罚款、无需等待的资金。

gloss.stock.def.en: A share of ownership in a company. Its price follows the company’s prospects.
gloss.stock.def.zh: 一家公司的一份所有权。股价随公司前景变化。

gloss.subscription.def.en: A charge that comes back at the same price month after month, whatever it buys: a phone plan as well as a streaming service. A purchase seen once is never one.
gloss.subscription.def.zh: 每月以相同价格重复扣款的费用，无论购买的是什么：手机套餐和流媒体服务都算。只出现过一次的消费不算订阅。

gloss.t_bill.def.en: Treasury bill: a government loan of a year or less, sold below its face value and repaid at face value.
gloss.t_bill.def.zh: 期限一年或更短的政府借款，以低于面值的价格发行，到期按面值偿还。

gloss.target_band.def.en: The range a part of the portfolio may drift within before you rebalance.
gloss.target_band.def.zh: 投资组合中某一部分在再平衡之前允许偏离的范围。

gloss.target_band.eg.en: A 40–45% band means rebalance below 40% or above 45%.
gloss.target_band.eg.zh: 40–45% 的区间表示：低于 40% 或高于 45% 时进行再平衡。

gloss.taxed_to_take_out.def.en: Money you can take out at any time, but what you take is taxed as income that year.
gloss.taxed_to_take_out.def.zh: 可随时取出的资金，但取出的金额计入当年收入纳税。

gloss.tfsa.def.en: Tax-Free Savings Account. Investments grow tax-free and nothing is taxed when you take money out. How much you can put in is capped by your contribution room.
gloss.tfsa.def.zh: 免税储蓄账户。账户内的投资增值免税，取款也无需纳税。可存入的金额受供款额度限制。

gloss.total_return.def.en: The change in price plus everything paid out, dividends and interest, over a period.
gloss.total_return.def.zh: 一段时间内价格的变化，加上期间派发的全部收益（分红和利息）。

gloss.unallocated.def.en: What is left of income once every line of the plan is paid. It stays where the income landed.
gloss.unallocated.def.zh: 收入支付完计划中各项后剩余的部分。这部分资金留在收入到账的账户中。

gloss.unrealized_gain.def.en: How much more an investment is worth today than you paid for it, while you still hold it. It is not money until you sell.
gloss.unrealized_gain.def.zh: 仍持有的投资，今天的价值高于买入成本的部分。卖出之前尚未实现。

gloss.unrealized_gain.eg.en: Bought for $1,000, worth $1,200 today: a $200 unrealized gain.

gloss.unrealized_gain.f.en: unrealized gain = market value − book value
gloss.unrealized_gain.f.zh: 浮盈 = 市值 − 成本

gloss.usual_month.def.en: What a month usually costs you: everything spent, averaged over your last full months, up to twelve, leaving out months you marked as unusual. A yearly charge counts as a twelfth each month.
gloss.usual_month.def.zh: 一个月的通常支出：最近若干个完整月份（最多十二个）全部支出的平均值，不含标记为异常的月份。按年支付的费用每月计入十二分之一。

gloss.why.compound.p1.en: Each year’s growth is earned on the whole balance, including the growth from earlier years. So the curve bends upward, and the late years add far more than the early ones.
gloss.why.compound.p1.zh: 每年的增长都基于全部余额计算，包括此前各年产生的增长。因此曲线向上弯曲，后期年份的增加额远大于早期。

gloss.why.compound.p2.en: Example: $10,000 growing 5% a year after inflation becomes $16,289 after 10 years, $26,533 after 20 and $43,219 after 30. The last ten years add $16,686, more than the first twenty combined. That is why time matters more than amount: a dollar invested ten years earlier gets an extra decade at the steep end of the curve.
gloss.why.compound.p2.zh: 示例：$10,000 按扣除通胀后每年 5% 增长，10 年后为 $16,289，20 年后为 $26,533，30 年后为 $43,219。最后十年增加 $16,686，超过前二十年的总和。因此时间比金额更重要：早十年投入的每一元，都会在曲线最陡的一段多增长十年。

gloss.why.compound.p3.en: Rule of 72: the years it takes to double ≈ 72 ÷ the yearly rate. At 5% that is about 14 years; at 8%, about 9.
gloss.why.compound.p3.zh: 72 法则：资产翻倍所需年数 ≈ 72 ÷ 年增长率。按 5% 计约 14 年；按 8% 计约 9 年。

gloss.why.compound.p4.en: It works against you too. A 1% yearly fee takes about a quarter of what you would have had after 30 years. Credit card interest compounds. So does inflation: at 2% a year, money loses half its buying power in about 36 years.
gloss.why.compound.p4.zh: 复利同样可能带来不利影响。每年 1% 的费用，30 年后会使最终金额减少约四分之一。信用卡利息也按复利计算。通胀同样如此：按每年 2% 计算，约 36 年后资金的购买力将减少一半。

gloss.why.compound.wrong1.en: Expecting a straight line. Compound growth describes the long-run average. Real markets get there through good years and bad ones.
gloss.why.compound.wrong1.zh: 以为增长是一条直线。复利描述的是长期平均水平，真实市场要经历上涨和下跌的年份才能达到。

gloss.why.registered.p1.en: All three answer one question: when is the tax paid?
gloss.why.registered.p1.zh: 这三种账户回答的是同一个问题：税在什么时候缴纳？

gloss.why.registered.p2.en: TFSA: on the way in. You put in money that has already been taxed. Growth and withdrawals are never taxed.
gloss.why.registered.p2.zh: TFSA：存入时缴税。存入的是已完税的资金。之后的增长和取款均不再纳税。

gloss.why.registered.p3.en: RRSP: on the way out. What you put in comes off this year’s taxable income. Everything you take out later is taxed as income in the year you take it.
gloss.why.registered.p3.zh: RRSP：取出时缴税。存入的金额可从当年应税收入中扣除。日后取出的全部金额，均在取出当年计入收入纳税。

gloss.why.registered.p4.en: FHSA: never, if the money buys a first home. It is deductible going in, like an RRSP, and tax-free coming out, like a TFSA. It is the only account with both, which is why it is limited to a first home, $8,000 a year and $40,000 in all.
gloss.why.registered.p4.zh: FHSA：如资金用于购买首套房，则始终无需缴税。存入时可抵税，与 RRSP 相同；取出时免税，与 TFSA 相同。它是唯一同时具备这两项优惠的账户，因此仅限用于购买首套房，每年上限 $8,000，累计上限 $40,000。

gloss.why.registered.p5.en: If the tax rate is the same at both ends, the TFSA and the RRSP come out identical. Say you earn $1,000 and the tax rate is 30%. In a TFSA, $700 goes in, doubles to $1,400, and you take out $1,400. In an RRSP, $1,000 goes in, doubles to $2,000, and 30% is taxed on the way out: $1,400 again. The RRSP comes out ahead only when your rate on the way out is lower than your rate on the way in, and the TFSA comes out ahead when it is higher. (This assumes the RRSP’s tax refund is invested too.)
gloss.why.registered.p5.zh: 如果存入和取出时的税率相同，TFSA 和 RRSP 的结果完全相同。假设收入 $1,000，税率 30%。存入 TFSA 的是 $700，翻倍至 $1,400，取出 $1,400。存入 RRSP 的是 $1,000，翻倍至 $2,000，取出时缴纳 30% 的税：同样是 $1,400。只有取出时的税率低于存入时，RRSP 才更有利；取出时税率更高，则 TFSA 更有利。（此处假设 RRSP 带来的退税也用于投资。）

gloss.why.registered.wrong1.en: A TFSA is not only a savings account. It can hold stocks and funds.
gloss.why.registered.wrong1.zh: TFSA 不仅是储蓄账户，也可以持有股票和基金。

gloss.why.registered.wrong2.en: Money taken out of a TFSA gives its room back, but not until 1 January. Putting it back in the same year can be an over-contribution, taxed at 1% a month.
gloss.why.registered.wrong2.zh: 从 TFSA 取出的金额会恢复相应额度，但要到次年 1月1日才恢复。同一年内再次存入，可能构成超额供款，超出部分每月需缴纳 1% 的税。

gloss.why.registered.wrong3.en: Money taken out of an RRSP loses that room for good, and tax is withheld at the time.
gloss.why.registered.wrong3.zh: 从 RRSP 取出的金额，对应的额度将永久失去，并且取款时会预扣税款。

gloss.why.registered.wrong4.en: FHSA room starts in the year you open the account. Earlier years do not count. FHSA money you do not use for a home can move to an RRSP without using RRSP room.
gloss.why.registered.wrong4.zh: FHSA 额度从开户当年开始累积，此前的年份不计。未用于购房的 FHSA 资金可转入 RRSP，且不占用 RRSP 额度。

gloss.why.registered.wrong5.en: An RRSP has to be closed by the end of the year you turn 71: moved into a RRIF, used to buy an annuity, or taken out as income.
gloss.why.registered.wrong5.zh: RRSP 必须在你年满 71 岁当年年底前关闭：转为 RRIF、用于购买年金，或作为收入取出。

gloss.why.withdrawal.p1.en: Why not just withdraw the average return? Because the average is not what a retiree lives through. Money taken out during a crash means selling low, and those shares are gone before the recovery comes. So the safe rate is set by the worst years in history to start, not by the average year. In US history, the worst were retirements that began in the late 1960s, just before a decade of high inflation.
gloss.why.withdrawal.p1.zh: 为什么不直接按平均回报提取？因为退休者实际经历的并不是平均值。在市场大跌时取款意味着低价卖出，这些份额在市场回升之前就已不复存在。因此，安全提取率取决于历史上最糟糕的起始年份，而不是平均年份。在美国历史上，最糟糕的是始于 1960 年代末的退休，随后便是长达十年的高通胀。

gloss.why.withdrawal.p2.en: The rule is about the first year. You take 4% of the starting portfolio. After that you take the same dollar amount, raised with inflation, whatever markets do. It is not 4% of each year’s balance.
gloss.why.withdrawal.p2.zh: 这条法则针对的是第一年。第一年提取起始投资组合的 4%。此后每年提取相同金额，并随通胀上调，不论市场表现如何。它不是每年余额的 4%。

gloss.why.withdrawal.p3.en: Its limits. It was tested on 30-year retirements, on a mix of US stocks and bonds, with no fees, using the history of one of the best-performing markets of the century. A longer retirement needs a lower rate: studies of 40- to 60-year retirements often land around 3–3.5%. ×25 is the same as 4%; ×30 is about 3.3%.
gloss.why.withdrawal.p3.zh: 局限性。它基于 30 年的退休期测试，使用美国股票和债券的组合，不计费用，并采用上个世纪表现最好的市场之一的历史数据。退休期越长，提取率就要越低：针对 40 至 60 年退休期的研究，结果通常在 3–3.5% 左右。×25 相当于 4%；×30 约为 3.3%。

gloss.why.withdrawal.wrong1.en: “4% lasts forever.” It was tested on 30 years.
gloss.why.withdrawal.wrong1.zh: “4% 可以永久维持。”它只针对 30 年进行了测试。

gloss.why.withdrawal.wrong2.en: “The rule says the money runs out at 30 years.” In many past periods there was more left after 30 years than at the start. 4% is the rate that survived the worst periods.
gloss.why.withdrawal.wrong2.zh: “这条法则说资金在第 30 年会用完。”在过去的许多时期，30 年后剩余的资金比开始时还多。4% 是在最糟糕的时期也能维持下来的提取率。

gloss.withdrawal_rate.def.en: How much you take out in a year, as a share of the portfolio.
gloss.withdrawal_rate.def.zh: 一年内取出的金额占投资组合的比例。

gloss.withdrawal_rate.f.zh: 每年提取金额 ÷ 投资组合

gloss.withholding_tax.def.en: Tax taken out before a payment reaches you.
gloss.withholding_tax.def.zh: 款项支付给你之前预先扣除的税款。

gloss.withholding_tax.eg.en: 15% is usually kept from US dividends paid to Canadians.
gloss.withholding_tax.eg.zh: 美国公司向加拿大居民派发的分红，通常预扣 15% 的税。

home.interest_sum.en: Interest charged on your credit card statements over the last 12 months.
home.interest_sum.zh: 过去 12 个月信用卡对账单上收取的利息。

home.inv_sum.zh: 以 {broker} 收到款项的日期为准。

home.inv_sum_noplan.en: Counted the day {broker} receives it. The plan has no investing amount yet.
home.inv_sum_noplan.zh: 以 {broker} 收到款项的日期为准。月度计划中尚未设置每月投资金额。

home.nw_gap_few.en: {months} had no update, so the line is dashed across them.
home.nw_gap_few.zh: {months}没有导入数据，这几个月以虚线表示。

home.nw_gap_many.en: {n} months had no update; the line is dashed across them.
home.nw_gap_many.zh: 有 {n} 个月没有导入数据，这些月份以虚线表示。

home.nw_gap_one.en: {months} had no update, so the line is dashed across it.
home.nw_gap_one.zh: {months}没有导入数据，该月以虚线表示。

home.nw_hollow.en: The hollow point counts Canadian accounts only.
home.nw_hollow.zh: 空心点仅包含加拿大账户。

home.port_sum.en: Every account you hold to grow. Set-aside accounts and bank cash are not in it.
home.port_sum.zh: 所有用于长期增值的账户，不包括专款专用账户和银行现金。

home.spent_sum_many_going.en: {n} purchases, and the month is still going.

home.spent_sum_many_partial.en: {n} purchases, and not every statement for it is in yet.
home.spent_sum_many_partial.zh: {n} 笔消费，该月对账单尚未收齐。

home.spent_sum_one_going.en: {n} purchase, and the month is still going.

home.spent_sum_one_partial.en: {n} purchase, and not every statement for it is in yet.
home.spent_sum_one_partial.zh: {n} 笔消费，该月对账单尚未收齐。

home.subs_sum.en: Every charge that repeats, at this year's rate.
home.subs_sum.zh: 所有定期扣款项目，按今年的扣款水平折算为全年金额。

inv.band_note.en: Measured at {broker}, set-aside accounts left out.
inv.band_note.zh: 按 {broker} 的持仓计算，不含专款专用账户。

inv.band_note_down.en: Measured at {broker}, excluding set-aside accounts. Down {n} percentage points since {date}.
inv.band_note_down.zh: 按 {broker} 的持仓计算，不含专款专用账户。自 {date} 以来下降 {n} 个百分点。

inv.band_note_up.en: Measured at {broker}, excluding set-aside accounts. Up {n} percentage points since {date}.
inv.band_note_up.zh: 按 {broker} 的持仓计算，不含专款专用账户。自 {date} 以来上升 {n} 个百分点。

inv.donut_empty.en: Nothing invested yet. Your first broker report fills this.
inv.donut_empty.zh: 尚无投资。导入首份券商报表后，此处将显示内容。

inv.holdings_empty.en: No positions yet. Your first broker report fills this table.
inv.holdings_empty.zh: 尚无持仓。导入首份券商报表后，此表将显示内容。

inv.port_note.en: Bank cash and set-aside accounts are left out.
inv.port_note.zh: 不含银行现金和专款专用账户。

inv.unclassed_many.en: {symbols} have no asset class yet, so they are shown under Not classified. Once their asset class is recorded, they move to that class.
inv.unclassed_many.zh: {symbols} 尚未设定资产类别，因此暂列于“未分类”。记录资产类别后，将归入相应类别。

inv.unclassed_one.en: {symbols} has no asset class yet, so it is shown under Not classified. Once its asset class is recorded, it moves to that class.
inv.unclassed_one.zh: {symbols} 尚未设定资产类别，因此暂列于“未分类”。记录资产类别后，将归入相应类别。

money.pension_note.en: From {source}, in today’s dollars. From that age, it pays part of your spending and care, so less is withdrawn from your portfolio.
money.pension_note.zh: 来自{source}，按当前币值计算。从该年龄起，养老金支付部分支出和护理费用，从投资组合中提取的金额相应减少。

money.pension_note_dated.en: From {source}, {date}, in today’s dollars. From that age, it pays part of your spending and care, so less is withdrawn from your portfolio.
money.pension_note_dated.zh: 来自{source}（{date}），按当前币值计算。从该年龄起，养老金支付部分支出和护理费用，从投资组合中提取的金额相应减少。

money.pensions_not_counted_note.en: CPP and OAS are not included in this plan yet. Once the estimates from your My Service Canada account are added, each pays part of your spending from the age it starts.
money.pensions_not_counted_note.zh: CPP 和 OAS 尚未计入本计划。加入 My Service Canada 账户中的估算金额后，两者将从各自的起领年龄起支付部分支出。

money.shortfall_note.en: What is still to pay after the money has run out — spending and care, less any pensions — added up in today’s money.
money.shortfall_note.zh: 资金耗尽后仍需支付的部分（支出加护理费用，减去养老金），按当前币值合计。

nw.part.cash.def.en: Bank accounts and cash in Canada used for day-to-day spending. The money is available at any time.
nw.part.cash.def.zh: 位于加拿大、用于日常支出的银行账户和现金，可随时动用。

nw.part.cash_abroad.def.en: Cash held abroad, in the currency it is held in. It counts in net worth, but spending it here means converting and transferring it first.
nw.part.cash_abroad.def.zh: 存放在境外、以原币种持有的现金。计入净值，但在加拿大使用前需先换汇并转账。

nw.part.for_fire.def.en: Money whose job is to grow until you stop working. FIRE progress is measured on this, whatever it holds today: stocks, bonds, or cash waiting to be invested.
nw.part.for_fire.def.zh: 用于长期增值、直到停止工作的资金。FIRE 进度以此计算，无论其当前持有的是股票、债券，还是待投资的现金。

nw.part.other.def.en: Things you own that are not money, such as a home or a car, at the value you last stated.
nw.part.other.def.zh: 所拥有的非货币资产，例如房产、汽车，按最近一次填写的价值计算。

nw.part.owed.def.en: Money you lent, counted until it is paid back.
nw.part.owed.def.zh: 借给他人的款项，在还清前一直计入。

nw.part.set_aside.def.en: Money reserved for a goal, such as a first home or a trip. It is not counted in FIRE progress or in Cash to invest.
nw.part.set_aside.def.zh: 已指定用途的资金，例如首套房或旅行。它不计入 FIRE 进度，也不计入待投现金。

perf.bench_ret_sum.en: Its total return, including dividends, converted to Canadian dollars at each day’s exchange rate.
perf.bench_ret_sum.zh: 按总回报计算（含分红），每日按当日汇率换算为加元。

perf.book_income_note.en: The {amount} of dividends and interest paid out in {year} is in neither part.
perf.book_income_note.zh: {year}年派发的 {amount} 分红和利息不计入以上两部分。

perf.growth_accounts_sum.en: The {broker} accounts held to grow, on {date}. Funds abroad are left out on both sides.
perf.growth_accounts_sum.zh: 截至 {date}，{broker} 中用于长期投资的账户。对比双方均不含境外资金。

perf.hover_snapshot.zh:
{date}
{broker} 投资组合：{amount}
同等资金投入 {symbol}：{amount_bench}

perf.legend_actual.en: Portfolio at {broker}, value at each update
perf.legend_actual.zh: {broker} 投资组合，每次导入时的市值

perf.legend_bench.zh: 同等资金投入 {symbol}，每日市值

perf.moves_sum_many.en: Transfers in minus transfers out, across {n} transfers. Transfers between two accounts in the portfolio are not counted.
perf.moves_sum_many.zh: 转入减转出，共 {n} 笔。投资组合内两个账户之间的转账不计入。

perf.moves_sum_one.en: {n} transfer in or out. Transfers between two accounts in the portfolio are not counted.
perf.moves_sum_one.zh: 共 {n} 笔转入或转出。投资组合内两个账户之间的转账不计入。

perf.no_benchmark.en: No benchmark has been selected. The comparison appears after the next update once one is selected.
perf.no_benchmark.zh: 尚未选定基准。选定后，下次导入时会显示对比。

perf.put_in_added.en: What you put in, and what the market added
perf.put_in_added.zh: 投入本金与市场带来的增值

perf.same_money_sum.en: {fund_name}. {why} Each deposit is counted as invested in this fund on the day it arrived at {broker}.
perf.same_money_sum.zh: {fund_name}。{why}每笔资金按到达 {broker} 当天买入该基金计算。

perf.too_short.en: {Span} is too short to judge one fund against a portfolio.
perf.too_short.zh: {Span}太短，不足以判断单只基金与投资组合的优劣。

port.stale.en: Holdings are as of {date}, {n} days ago. To update them, export your holdings from {broker} again.
port.stale.zh: 持仓数据截至 {date}，已有 {n} 天未更新。如需更新，请从 {broker} 重新导出持仓。

reach.abroad.desc.en: Money held in another country. It can be accessed, but currency conversion and transfer limits mean it takes time
reach.abroad.desc.zh: 存放在境外的资金。可以动用，但需要换汇，并受转账额度限制，需要一定时间

reach.costs.desc.en: Registered retirement accounts such as an RRSP. Withdrawals are allowed but are taxed as income in the year they are made
reach.costs.desc.zh: 注册退休账户，例如 RRSP。可以取款，但取出金额须计入当年收入纳税

reach.lent.desc.en: Money you lent. It comes back only as it is repaid, on the borrower's timetable
reach.lent.desc.zh: 借给他人的款项。只能按借款人的还款进度收回

reach.locked.desc.en: The property's value minus what is still owed on it. It can be accessed only by selling the property or borrowing against it
reach.locked.desc.zh: 房产价值减去尚欠的贷款。只能通过出售房产或以房产抵押借款取得

reach.spoken.desc.en: Earmarked for a purpose. Reachable, but spending it means giving up what it was for
reach.spoken.desc.zh: 已指定用途的资金。可以动用，但动用即意味着放弃原定目标

reach.today.desc.en: Investment and cash accounts with no age restriction and no penalty on withdrawals
reach.today.desc.zh: 取款不受年龄限制、也没有罚款的投资账户和现金账户

set.ai.history_note.en: The names of the 15 categories went with each one.
set.ai.history_note.zh: 每次发送均附带 15 个类别的名称。

set.ai.key_chatgpt_plan.en: A ChatGPT Plus plan does not come with one.
set.ai.key_chatgpt_plan.zh: ChatGPT Plus 订阅不包含 API 密钥。

set.ai.key_claude_plan.en: A Claude Pro plan does not come with one.
set.ai.key_claude_plan.zh: Claude Pro 订阅不包含 API 密钥。

set.ai.key_ph.zh: 粘贴你的 {company} API 密钥

set.ai.meta_off_deletes_key.en: Turning it off deletes the key

set.ai.model_why.en: Installed in Ollama on this computer.
set.ai.model_why.zh: 已安装在本机的 Ollama 中。

set.ai.needs_app.en: AI assist works when this page is opened with the FIRE Toad app on your computer.
set.ai.needs_app.zh: AI 辅助仅在通过本机的 FIRE蛙 应用打开本页时可用。

set.ai.ollama_open.en: Ollama has to be open when you import. When it is not, the import goes on without it.
set.ai.ollama_open.zh: 导入时需保持 Ollama 运行。如未运行，导入将照常进行，但不使用 AI 辅助。

set.ai.once_on.en: Once it is on, a merchant the app does not know is sent to {company} by name, to ask which category fits. Amounts, dates and accounts are not sent.
set.ai.once_on.zh: 开启后，应用无法识别的商户会以名称发送给 {company}，以确定适用的类别。不会发送金额、日期和账户。

set.ai.prepaid.en: A key is paid for in advance: you add credit first, and a month of merchants costs less than a cent.
set.ai.prepaid.zh: API 密钥需预先充值，一个月的商户查询费用不到 1 美分。

set.ai.sent.en: What is sent: the merchant as the statement prints it, and the names of the 15 categories. Never an amount, a date or an account.
set.ai.sent.zh: 发送内容：对账单上显示的商户名称，以及 15 个类别的名称。不会发送金额、日期或账户。

set.ai.service_local.en: Works on this computer. Nothing is sent.
set.ai.service_local.zh: 在本机运行，不发送任何内容。

set.ai.service_why.en: The AI service your merchant names are sent to.
set.ai.service_why.zh: 接收商户名称的 AI 服务。

set.ai.terms.en: How {company} keeps what it receives is up to its own terms. FIRE Toad cannot control that.
set.ai.terms.zh: {company} 如何保存所收到的内容，取决于其自身条款，FIRE蛙 无法控制。

set.ai.toast_no_answer.en: Not saved. The app did not answer.

set.ai.what.en: Suggests a category for a merchant the app does not know. You still choose each one.
set.ai.what.zh: 为应用无法识别的商户建议类别，最终类别仍由你逐一选择。

set.locked.en: Calculated from several lines in Budget. To change it, change those lines.
set.locked.zh: 由月度计划中的几项合计得出。如需修改，请修改相应项目。

set.mix_past.en: Your current asset allocation had an average real return of about {pct}% a year from {year_from} to {year_to}.
set.mix_past.zh: 按当前的资产配置，{year_from}年至 {year_to}年间的平均实际回报约为每年 {pct}%。

set.need_app.en: Open this page with the FIRE Toad app to change it
set.need_app.zh: 如需修改，请在 FIRE蛙 应用中打开本页

set.note_demo.en: This is the demo. Changes are shown but not saved.
set.note_demo.zh: 当前为演示版本。修改会显示，但不会保存。

set.note_read.en: These numbers can be read here, not changed. Open this page with the FIRE Toad app to change them.
set.note_read.zh: 此处仅供查看，不可修改。如需修改，请在 FIRE蛙 应用中打开本页。

set.subtitle.en: The numbers that are yours to choose. A change is saved as you make it.
set.subtitle.zh: 由你自行设定的数字。修改后自动保存。

set.toast_busy.en: Not saved: an import is running. Change it again when the import is done.
set.toast_busy.zh: 未保存：正在导入。导入完成后请重新修改。

set.toast_no_answer.en: Not saved. The app did not respond. Check that FIRE Toad is still open, then try again.
set.toast_no_answer.zh: 未保存。应用没有响应。请确认 FIRE蛙 仍在运行，然后重试。

set.unset_tip.en: Not set yet. Set {how} on the Settings page.
set.unset_tip.zh: 尚未设置。请在「设置」页设定{how}。

shell.header_nothing_filed.en: No statements have been imported yet. Import your first statements in the FIRE Toad app.
shell.header_nothing_filed.zh: 尚未导入对账单。请在 FIRE蛙 应用中导入第一批对账单。

shell.header_wait_file.zh: {n} 笔待分类，请在 FIRE蛙 中处理

shell.month_missing_list.en: Some statements for {month} have not arrived yet: {list}. The month's totals will increase when they arrive.
shell.month_missing_list.zh: {month}的对账单尚未收齐：{list}。收齐后，该月合计会增加。

shell.month_missing_nolist.en: Not every statement for {month} is in yet. Its totals will rise.
shell.month_missing_nolist.zh: {month}的对账单尚未收齐。收齐后，该月合计会增加。

shell.month_still_going.en: {month} is still going, so its totals will rise.
shell.month_still_going.zh: {month}尚未结束，该月合计还会增加。

shell.nw_abroad_note.en: {amount} of it is held abroad, converted at the {date} rate.
shell.nw_abroad_note.zh: 其中 {amount} 为境外资产，按 {date} 汇率换算。

shell.pill_partial_title.en: Some statements for this month have not arrived yet
shell.pill_partial_title.zh: 该月的对账单尚未收齐

shell.wait_fire_goal.zh: 需要先设定 FIRE 目标

spend.ins_peak_month.en: {month} was the biggest month: {amount}, {x}× the monthly average.
spend.ins_peak_month.zh: {month}是支出最多的月份：{amount}，为月均支出的 {x} 倍。

spend.ins_subs_biggest.en: Subscriptions cost {amount}, {pct}% of spending. The biggest is {brand}, at {brand_amount}.
spend.ins_subs_biggest.zh: 订阅支出 {amount}，占总支出的 {pct}%。其中最高的是 {brand}，为 {brand_amount}。

spend.ins_top_cat.en: {category} is the biggest category: {amount}, {pct}% of the year’s spending.
spend.ins_top_cat.zh: {category}是支出最多的类别：{amount}，占全年支出的 {pct}%。

src.legend.en: A filled dot means that month’s statement has been received. A hollow amber ring means it is due and not yet received. A small grey dot means it is not due yet. An amber day count beside the date means the latest statement is more than 30 days old.
src.legend.zh: 实心圆点表示当月对账单已收到；空心黄圈表示已到期但尚未收到；灰色小点表示尚未到期。日期旁的黄色天数表示最近一份对账单已超过 30 天。

src.th_month_initial.en: J F M A M J J A S O N D

subs.charges.zh: 共扣费 {n} 次，最近一次 {date}

subs.charges_one.zh: 共扣费 {n} 次，最近一次 {date}

subs.full_year_note.en: The average per month this year, multiplied by twelve.
subs.full_year_note.zh: 今年平均每月金额乘以 12。

subs.too_few_months.en: A charge counts as a subscription once it comes back three months running. Your statements cover {n} months so far.
subs.too_few_months.zh: 同一笔扣款连续三个月出现，才计为订阅。目前对账单仅涵盖 {n} 个月。

subs.too_few_months_one.en: A charge counts as a subscription once it comes back three months running. Your statements cover {n} month so far.
subs.too_few_months_one.zh: 同一笔扣款连续三个月出现，才计为订阅。目前对账单仅涵盖 {n} 个月。

subs.what_counts.en: Every recurring charge is included, from a phone plan to a streaming service. A one-time purchase is not.
subs.what_counts.zh: 所有定期重复的扣费均计入，从手机套餐到视频会员。一次性购买不计入。

subs.ytd_note.en: Every charge that repeats, this year.
subs.ytd_note.zh: 今年所有重复出现的扣款。

trends.per_month_note.en: {year} only, months not complete yet included.
trends.per_month_note.zh: 仅统计 {year}年，包括尚不完整的月份。

trends.per_month_note_usual.en: The monthly average, from your last full months, is {amount}.
trends.per_month_note_usual.zh: 月均支出（按最近几个完整月份计算）为 {amount}。

upd.asked_latest_none_many.en: Asked you {n} questions — none still waiting.
upd.asked_latest_none_many.zh: 提出 {n} 个问题，均已回答。

upd.asked_latest_none_one.en: Asked you {n} question — none still waiting.
upd.asked_latest_none_one.zh: 提出 {n} 个问题，均已回答。

upd.asked_latest_waiting_many.zh: 提出 {n} 个问题，尚有 {w} 个待回答。

upd.asked_latest_waiting_one.zh: 提出 {n} 个问题，尚有 {w} 个待回答。

upd.choose_hint.en: Choose an update to read it above.
upd.choose_hint.zh: 选择一次导入，在上方查看。

upd.decided.zh: 未经询问即决定的事项

upd.empty.en: No updates yet. Updates appear here after your first statements are imported.
upd.empty.zh: 暂无导入记录。导入第一批对账单后，记录将显示在此处。

wsinc.closed_months_many.zh: 按 {n} 个完整月份平均计算。

wsinc.closed_months_one.zh: 按 1 个完整月份计算。

wsinc.empty_months.en: No investment income on record yet.

wsinc.month_open.en: {month} is still open, so its totals will rise.
wsinc.month_open.zh: {month}尚未结束，合计金额还会增加。

wsinc.year_fx_note.zh: 美元金额按 1 美元 = ${rate} 换算。
